newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti declines comment on Acer report.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti declines comment on Acer report.

text.p: Troubled Italian information technology group Olivetti said on Friday it had no comment on reports that it was talking to Taiwanese group Acer.
"We don't have any comment on this," a spokesman said.
The editor of business daily MF earlier retracted a report in which it quoted Olivetti managing director Roberto Colaninno as saying Olivetti was in talks to sell the PC business to Acer.

But he stood by another report in the same edition which quoted the head of Acer's Italian operations, Aldo Grech as saying Acer was in ongoing talks with Olivetti. Grech did not specify the nature of the contacts.
